scope: 014 V-probe source and embedded notebook identity; read-only source review and manual CPU checks; no GPU run or dependency download

runtime_evidence.source: Parent reviewer supplied CLI v4 logs; reviewer independently read extracted v-probe-v4/vprobe/run.json and pip-install.log
runtime_evidence.import_failure_cause: Confirmed ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'vllm'. Installer only installs requirements-qwen38-runtime.txt, whose noncomment requirements do not include vllm. --find-links supplies a search directory but does not install all wheels in it. The present vllm wheel was omitted from both installer branches.
runtime_evidence.interpretation: Known negative outcomes intentionally exit 0. Kaggle COMPLETE confirms process completion, not working CUDA inference. V00 explains the observed import failure; subsequent prospective findings are independent issues not reached by this run. The run did not validate server startup, true generation, TP4 throughput, or P2 accuracy. Driver and hardware are observed, but real CUDA kernel compatibility remains unverified.

source_identity.notebook_location: cell 1; notebook JSON is one physical line
source_identity.vdriver_difference: Local file adds shutil/site cleanup and longer/more visible import diagnostics. Those changes are absent in embedded notebook and remote boot.

findings.title: Installer omits the vLLM wheel and installs only its dependencies
findings.evidence: Both pip branches supply only --requirement <requirements-qwen38-runtime.txt>. Independent inspection found no noncomment vllm requirement, and the remote successful-install list contains no vllm distribution. The exact run.json error is ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'vllm'. The frozen wheelhouse manifest explicitly contains wheels/vllm-0.27.2rc1.dev91+g1f7427bc0-cp38-abi3-manylinux_2_28_x86_64.whl (314186529 bytes), so the wheel exists in the chosen asset but is not requested by the command.
findings.manual_cpu_reproduction: Read extracted remote run.json/pip-install.log, enumerated requirements after excluding comments, matched zero vllm requirements, checked zero vllm distribution occurrences in the install log, and independently matched the vllm wheel path/hash in the frozen manifest. No installation or GPU run was performed.
findings.impact: Every clean execution of this installer reaches import_vllm_failed before template checking, server startup, or generation. This is the identified reason v4 did not test the 27B model; it is not a model-performance result or a demonstrated CUDA incompatibility.
findings.recommendation: Validate the exact local vllm wheel SHA and add that wheel explicitly to the same offline pip install invocation in both native-3.12 and fallback branches, alongside the dependency requirements. Do not assume --find-links installs all wheels. Repack the notebook and verify payload hashes before a bounded retry; preserve actual import and CUDA generation evidence.

findings.title: Streaming usage is neither requested nor correctly consumed
findings.evidence: Request omits stream_options.include_usage. Parser indexes choices[0] before reading usage, so the standard final choices=[] usage chunk is skipped by the exception handler.
findings.manual_cpu_reproduction: Imported the current module without writing bytecode; replaced urlopen with an in-memory response containing reasoning delta, final content/stop delta, then choices=[] with completion_tokens=11. Actual output: request stream_options=None, usage={}, agg_tok_s=None; final grid parsed as [[1]]. No test file/framework was created.
findings.impact: Successful future generation may still yield no token count or throughput, blocking the T-stage budget decision.
findings.recommendation: Request streaming usage, parse usage before optional choices, preserve per-request token totals, and explicitly mark missing usage as insufficient throughput evidence.

findings.title: Stage and session budgets are checked after work rather than enforced as absolute deadlines
findings.evidence: urlopen timeout bounds blocking socket operations rather than total streamed response time. No elapsed-time check exists inside the read loop. Server readiness permits 1500s separately after installation; combined installation/load >1200s is checked only once the server is ready. P2 checks session margin only before each call, and hello checks protocol budget only between calls.
findings.manual_cpu_reproduction: Source control-flow audit; no GPU timing claim. An active stream can continue past the nominal request wall-clock limit because the loop contains no deadline check.
findings.impact: A future working server can overrun the stated 20-minute load, 5-minute protocol, and 1-hour session budgets; timeout exceptions in setup may also bypass structured evidence output.
findings.recommendation: Use one monotonic session deadline and derived stage deadlines, bound each blocking operation by remaining time, check active streams, cancel/abort timed-out requests, and use an outer process-group deadline with final evidence persistence.

findings.title: A truncated hello with empty final output can pass protocol admission
findings.evidence: Admission requires only any nonempty finish_reason and no client_error; length is accepted, final content is not required, and one successful effort is enough.
findings.manual_cpu_reproduction: Evaluated the actual acceptance predicate with finish_reason=length, reasoning_chars=4096, content_chars=0: accepted. Separately, extract_final_grid(content, length) returned None as intended.
findings.impact: Can enter P2 without proving that both effort modes produce a complete final response. This is not evidence that P2 truncated responses are counted as correct; P2 grid extraction correctly rejects length.
findings.recommendation: Record generation observed, protocol complete, and valid answer separately; require both effort modes to satisfy the intended protocol check before admission.

findings.title: C4 is a server limit, but actual client requests are serial
findings.evidence: Nested query/effort loops call chat_once synchronously. No small-concurrency phase is present.
findings.manual_cpu_reproduction: Source control-flow audit; no throughput experiment performed.
findings.impact: Even with usage fixed, the result would measure single-request throughput and cannot establish C4 aggregate throughput required for scaling T.
findings.recommendation: After a single-request success, run one predetermined small concurrent wave and compute sum(completion_tokens) divided by common wave wall time, with actual concurrency and per-request timing recorded.

findings.title: Current local vdriver edits are absent from the notebook payload

locations.detail: cell 1 base64 payload and expected hash

findings.evidence: Decoded the embedded three-file package with AST/base64 and compared byte hashes. Only vdriver differs; embedded hash matches the parent-supplied remote boot hash.
findings.manual_cpu_reproduction: Byte comparison and unified diff showed missing site cleanup and enhanced import diagnostics in embedded vdriver. Other two payload files match current local bytes.
findings.impact: Pushing the existing notebook does not deploy current local fixes; embedded version can export the multi-GB isolated site directory.
findings.recommendation: Repack from the reviewed source after edits, verify all payload hashes, and record the exact remote version/boot hashes separately from local source.

findings.title: Saved responses truncate reasoning and final text
findings.evidence: Driver saves only first 2000 reasoning characters and last 4000 P2 final characters, although plan requires original responses.
findings.manual_cpu_reproduction: Direct source inspection of slicing before write_text.
findings.impact: Prevents later diagnosis of long-reasoning termination and exact protocol behavior.
findings.recommendation: Save full content and reasoning as separate evidence files; limit only human-readable summaries.

findings.title: Valid-grid admission accepts values outside ARC colors
findings.evidence: isdigit checks numeric text, not color range 0-9; no dimension range check is applied before answered=true.
findings.manual_cpu_reproduction: extract_final_grid with stop and a closed fence containing rows '10 11' and '12 13' returned [[10,11],[12,13]].
findings.impact: Future answered counts can include invalid ARC outputs, weakening completion admission evidence; this alone does not imply exact-match scoring would count them correct.
findings.recommendation: Validate color values and legal grid dimensions before setting answered.

Include the pinned wheel explicitly with dependencies, fix prospective deadline/usage/protocol issues, and repack source before any new bounded V run.
